purpose: Teach: バンザイ/哀愁/消防署/道楽/人差し指/茄子/茂木/スリッパ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、合格したら家族でバンザイしましょうね
lines.en: Sho, when you pass, we'll all celebrate together as a family, won't we?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging certainty. Gentle lean forward. The tone of a mother already imagining the moment. Soft emphasis on 「合格したら」 — when, not if.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、哀愁漂う夕焼けを見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw the sunset today… it was kind of lonely and beautiful.
lines.style: Quiet, almost to himself. Small pause before 「見たよ」. The voice of a child noticing something adults usually miss. Slightly dreamy, not seeking reassurance — just sharing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと消防署の防災イベントに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you and Dad should go to the fire station event together. It'll be fun.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not a command. Warm but practical. The cadence of a mother setting up good memories. Slight lift at the end — inviting him to imagine it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが釣りを道楽にされてるそうよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard Grandpa really loves fishing. It's like his favorite hobby.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, slightly awed. The way a six-year-old relays information that impressed him. Small voice, genuine curiosity about what makes grown-ups tick.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きで人差し指を上手に使えるようになったわね
lines.en: Sho, you've gotten so good at holding your paintbrush with your index finger, haven't you?
lines.style: Warm praise that feels specific and noticed. Slight brightness in the voice — genuine delight at small growth. The tone of someone who actually watches what he does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの茄子のお漬物食べたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat Grandma's pickled eggplant. The ones she makes.
lines.style: Direct, eager request with that particular child-hunger. Soft opening on 「ぼく」. The voice of someone who knows exactly what he wants and isn't shy about asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが茂木さんと交流されてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's been spending more time with Mr. Mogi lately. They seem to get along well.
lines.style: Casual observation, slightly thoughtful. Not quite gossipy but sharing something she's noticed. The tone of a wife mentioning her husband's quiet friendships with gentle interest.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのスリッパが大きすぎだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's slippers are way too big for me — I can barely walk in them.
lines.style: Dry amusement, small laugh under the words. A child discovering an adult-sized absurdity. Matter-of-fact with a touch of mischief — not complaining, noticing something funny.
